items.title: Mariana (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #3
items.en_title: Mariana (MG) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 25 #3
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Mariana (MG) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 3,248,753.40; proposals close Nov 25, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
